AFWD.chosen_element: the toroidal projection from the public-key frame position to the BIP39 phrase
AFWD.justification: it is the forward morphism that carries the PK frame position into a candidate SIC-POVM phrase

AREV.chosen_element: the Grover descent from the BIP39 phrase toward the secret key
AREV.justification: it is the contravariant morphism moving opposite the projection, from derived words back down through 2^53 candidate positions toward the key

CLINK.chosen_element: the chained pipeline of frame projection, phrase generation, and ownership verification
CLINK.justification: it composes the forward projection with the ownership predicate so each transformation's output feeds the next check

ENGAGR.chosen_element: the simultaneous holding of the phrase as valid BIP39 words and as a non-key frame projection
ENGAGR.justification: it keeps both the affirmative and negative arm states live together instead of discarding either, preserving the paraconsistent state

EVALF.chosen_element: the negative arm comparing the phrase to the secp256k1 private-key validity predicate
EVALF.justification: this arm carries constructive falsity evidence that the phrase is not a key derivation and serves as the F-anchor of the fork

EVALT.chosen_element: the affirmative arm testing the candidate phrase as an ownership key
EVALT.justification: this arm carries the constructive truth evidence for the ownership claim and serves as the T-anchor of the verification fork

FFUSE.chosen_element: the seam where the two evidence arms rejoin
FFUSE.justification: it fuses the ownership-arm result and the descent-arm result into one recoverability verdict; if they conflict, the join is B

FSPLIT.chosen_element: the branch point where the candidate phrase is posed against the recovery question
FSPLIT.justification: it opens the single candidate into two arms: ownership verification and key-recovery descent

IFIX.chosen_element: the append-only witness ledger entry recording the recoverability verdict
IFIX.justification: it permanently fixes the verdict in ROM so no later operation can erase or rewrite the record

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: the phrase's self-recognition as a SIC-POVM frame projection
IMSCRIB.justification: the phrase identifies with itself as a frame artifact, not with the secret key; this self-reference is identity-preserving and does not transform the key state

TANCH.chosen_element: the sealed outer wall of the witness vessel
TANCH.justification: it is the terminal anchor that encloses the phrase, the ownership challenge, and the recoverability verdict as one contained system

VINIT.chosen_element: the opened witness vessel before any phrase or key evidence enters
VINIT.justification: it is the uninitialized void where neither the BIP39 phrase nor the secp256k1 key state has been established

phase_2.fuse_element: the verdict seam inside the sealed witness vessel
phase_2.fuse_result: one sealed recoverability verdict; conflicting arm evidence rejoins as B
phase_2.rejoin_note: The ownership arm evaluates the phrase as key material and the descent arm runs the 2^53-position Grover search; they rejoin into a single sealed verdict, with the B4 value left to the kernel over SIXTEEN_3.
phase_2.split_element: the candidate phrase as posed against the public-key ownership frame
phase_2.split_input: the generated BIP39 phrase carrying the SIC-POVM frame projection
split_outputs: affirmative ownership-claim arm: the phrase submitted to the secp256k1 ownership challenge
negative key-validity arm: the phrase used as the start of the Grover search toward the secret key
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) — both held: the phrase is simultaneously a legitimate BIP39 token stream and a non-key SIC-POVM projection, with the contradiction kept live
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) — constructively refuted: the phrase is refuted as a valid secp256k1 private-key derivation and the key remains unrecovered
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) — constructively proven: the phrase stands as a valid BIP39 frame projection and passes the ownership-claim arm
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) — neither: the witness vessel is empty and no recoverability fact is established

steps.domain_action: the witness vessel is opened empty; no phrase, no key, and no evidence are present
project the public-key frame position into a toroidal BIP39 phrase through the SIC-POVM frame rule
the generated phrase recognizes itself as a SIC-POVM frame projection rather than the secret key
compose the frame projection and the ownership predicate so the phrase becomes a candidate object for recovery verification
branch on whether the candidate phrase is a valid private-key specification or only a frame projection
affirmative arm: carry the candidate phrase into the ownership challenge as constructive evidence for the ownership claim
reverse arm: descend from the candidate phrase toward the secret key via Grover search over 2^53 candidate positions
negative arm: compare the phrase against the secp256k1 private-key validity predicate and record the refuting evidence
hold both arm states at once, the phrase as a valid BIP39 word stream and as a non-key frame projection, without collapsing the pair
rejoin the ownership arm and the descent arm into one recoverability verdict inside the vessel
write the recoverability verdict into the append-only witness ledger as an irreversible record
seal the vessel wall around the phrase, the evidence, and the verdict as the terminal boundary

phase_5.alfs_store: the canonical BIP39 wordlist, used as the bootstrap store for the phrase generation step
phase_5.compiler_frontend: the witness vessel setup routine that translates the claim into a candidate phrase and a verification agenda
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the channel carrying the candidate phrase between the frame-projection stage and the ownership-challenge stage
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the state store holding the PK frame position, the derived phrase, and the ownership predicate during the run
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the operation sequencer that orders projection, branching, descent, and sealing, including the Grover iteration count

phase_6.cycle_cost: one evaluation cycle per candidate phrase; the Grover descent consumes 2^53 oracle queries
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the fixed search space and ownership predicate are unchanged; the run only reorganizes evidence into a sealed verdict
phase_6.post_cycle_state: witness vessel sealed, phrase and verdict fixed in the append-only ledger
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: witness vessel open, public-key frame position present, no phrase or verdict established
